title: Genuine bank call: suspicious card transaction
label: genuine
notes: Hard negative: mentions money, urgency and a transaction, but no officer, no accusation, no transfer demand.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste, main HDFC Bank ke fraud monitoring team se bol rahi hoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapke credit card pe abhi ₹45,000 ka ek transaction try hua hai, kya yeh aapne kiya?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Nahi, maine koi transaction nahi kiya.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Koi baat nahi, hum aapki safety ke liye card turant block kar rahe hain.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Naya card 7 din mein aapke registered address pe aa jayega.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yaad rakhiye, bank kabhi bhi call pe OTP, PIN ya password nahi maangta.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Agar aapko koi aur doubt hai toh card ke peeche likhe number pe call kar lijiye. Dhanyavaad.
